Diverging paths through small blank-sign doorways converge on one enormous stone gate bearing a penguin emblem. Gentle isometric game-map composition, muted blue backpacks, organic fading edges, no text, no charts, no captions. 3:2 landscape, high resolution for 4.6-inch-wide print.
